about: The Node.js the stage copies into the app (bundle.mjs checkNode, review e A-M3): this exact version, the official build (the Node.js project’s own download, signed by the project), its bin/node checked against this sha256 — the release workflow installs it with actions/setup-node and the build refuses any other binary. Upgrading: install the new version from the Node.js project’s downloads, check its SHASUMS256.txt signature, record the version here (and in .github/workflows/release.yml) with `shasum -a 256 <prefix>/bin/node`.
